skill.name: changelog
skill.description: Maintains IdeaVim CHANGES.md and JetBrains Marketplace changeNotes by reviewing releases, commits, PRs, and user-visible changes.
skill.summary: Helps keep IdeaVim release notes and marketplace change notes consistent.
skill.author: JetBrains

security_audit.summary: All static findings were false positives caused by Markdown inline code, fenced examples, documentation links, and changelog references in SKILL.md. No executable script, data exfiltration intent, prompt injection attempt, or system reconnaissance behavior was found.

static_findings.snippet: - Create a new empty `[To Be Released]` section after each release
- Focus on the `[To Be Released]` section and recent versions
- If a commit SHA is provided, use `git log <SHA>..HEAD --oneline` to see only unprocessed commits
- The `workflow-changelog` tag tracks the last successful changelog workflow run
- Use `git tag --list --sort=-version:refname` to see all version tags
- Use `git show <commit-hash>` to see the full commit content
- **API module changes** (while in experimental status) - Do not log changes to the `api` module as
- Good example: "Fixed `ci"` command in empty strings" or "Added support for `gn` text object"
- Better: Specify the actual case - "Fixed `3daw` deleting wrong number of words" or "Fixed cursor p

* Implemented `:tabmove` command - use `:tabmove +1` or `:tabmove -1` to reorder tabs
* Support for `z=` to show spelling suggestions
* [VIM-3260](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/VIM-3260) Fixed `G` command at file end with count

content.value_statement: Release notes can drift from commits and marketplace notes. This skill guides consistent IdeaVim changelog updates from tags, PRs, issues, and user-visible changes.
actual_capabilities: Reviews recent commits, tags, and merged PRs to identify user-visible IdeaVim changes.
Maintains the [To Be Released] section and version entries in CHANGES.md.
Formats feature, fix, change, and merged PR sections with ticket and PR references.
Keeps build.gradle.kts changeNotes aligned with the changelog.
Converts Markdown release notes into JetBrains Marketplace HTML formatting.
limitations: Designed for the IdeaVim project and its changelog conventions.
Requires repository, tag, PR, and issue context to produce accurate entries.
Does not decide product release scope or validate every issue link automatically.
May need network access for official documentation links and GitHub PR data.

use_cases.title: Prepare release notes
use_cases.description: Create a clean changelog section from recent IdeaVim commits, tags, and user-facing fixes.

use_cases.title: Review community PRs
use_cases.description: Identify merged external contributions that should be acknowledged in the changelog.

use_cases.title: Synchronize marketplace notes
use_cases.description: Convert finalized changelog entries into matching JetBrains Marketplace changeNotes content.

prompt_templates.title: Update unreleased notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current repository changes since the last changelog entry and update the [To Be Released] section for user-visible changes.

prompt_templates.title: Document a release
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 2.28.0 changelog entry from the current [To Be Released] section and keep the historical gap note in place.

prompt_templates.title: Audit PR history
prompt_templates.prompt: Review merged PRs since the last release, exclude dependency and internal-only changes, and add only qualifying changelog entries.

prompt_templates.title: Synchronize changeNotes
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert the finalized CHANGES.md [To Be Released] content into build.gradle.kts changeNotes HTML while preserving all entries and reward program text.

output_examples.input: A release contains a new text object, two YouTrack fixes, and one external contributor PR.
output_examples.output: A grouped changelog section with Features, Fixes, and Merged PRs. Each item includes the right issue or PR reference.

output_examples.input: The marketplace changeNotes are missing the latest unreleased entries.
output_examples.output: An aligned marketplace note set that preserves changelog wording and prepares links and command names for plugin page display.

output_examples.input: A commit only refactors internal API tests.
output_examples.output: No changelog entry is added because users cannot observe the change.

best_practices: Start from the current top of CHANGES.md before reviewing commits.
Inspect tests and code diffs before writing user-facing change descriptions.
Keep each change in one section with the correct ticket or PR reference.
anti_patterns: Do not list dependency, test-only, or internal refactoring changes as user-facing release notes.
Do not summarize changeNotes differently from the matching CHANGES.md section.
Do not create vague entries when the actual user-visible behavior is unclear.

faq.question: Is this skill only for IdeaVim?
faq.answer: Yes. Its rules, paths, issue links, and release history are specific to the IdeaVim project.

faq.question: Does it create release notes from commits?
faq.answer: It guides review of commits, tags, PRs, tests, and issues before writing user-facing entries.

faq.question: Can it update JetBrains Marketplace notes?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains how to keep build.gradle.kts changeNotes aligned with CHANGES.md.

faq.question: What changes should be excluded?
faq.answer: It excludes dependency updates, Claude-generated PRs, test-only work, documentation-only work, and invisible internal changes.

faq.question: Does it need GitHub access?
faq.answer: GitHub access helps it review merged PRs and comments. Local git history is also required for accurate release notes.

faq.question: Can it handle old changelog gaps?
faq.answer: Yes. It preserves the note for versions 2.10.0 through 2.27.0, where the changelog was not maintained.
